mapper.select: /*selectMasterMdCtStndrdContractPopList*/ SELECT A.FORM_NAME ,TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.ADD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY/MM/DD') AS ADD_DATE ,A.FORM_TYPE ,COUNT(B.RFORM_NO) AS RFORM_CNT ,A.FORM_NO FROM ICOMECCF A, ICOMECRF B WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND A.FORM_NO = B.FORM_NO(+) AND B.MANDATORY_YN(+) = 'Y' AND BIZ_TYPE = #{st_biz_type} AND A.COMPANY_TYPE LIKE #{st_company_type} || '%' AND A.FORM_TYPE LIKE #{st_form_type} || '%' GROUP BY A.FORM_NO, A.FORM_NAME, A.ADD_DATE, A.FORM_TYPE ORDER BY A.FORM_NO
